title: BraineumStash
tagline: A federated-cpu-miner, wallet, running on Braineum, a scaled-up Ethereum system, with links to DeFi and a Bitcoin like ecosystem.
description: This project will provide a federated-cpu-miner and wallet to the Braineum system which was conceptualized during the Scaling Ethereum Hackathon. Additionally, links to the DeFi ecosystem and a DeX will be integrated and finally a link to the Bitcoin ecosystem. This project is about democratizing mining so that CPUs and mobiles can participate in mining process.
how_its_made: This project will be built with React, Node, Ethereum, and integrated with (didn't make it: Aave, Compound, Connext). Although this hackathon was 3 weeks long I had other pressing matters so I was only able to spend the last weekend on this project. Therefore I couldn't incorporate the sponsors into this system.
